summary.text: Kathy Hogan is a Democratic member of the North Dakota Senate, representing District 21 (home city listed as Fargo), serving in the House from 2009 to 2018 and in the Senate since 2019 per the legislature's member page; the page lists the role of Minority Leader.

paragraphs.text: The legislature's biography for Hogan lists an occupation of Retired.
It lists education as BA, Sociology, University of Jamestown; MS, Educational Counseling, NDSU.
For the 2025 regular session, the page lists Hogan's standing committee assignments as Human Services and Transportation.
